About the Job Seeking Skills event

Job Seeking Skills is a Leadership event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Job Seeking Skills solo event (secondary and postsecondary), following the 2026–27 guidelines and rating sheets: choosing and researching a real health-related opportunity, planning and writing a two-page personal statement, building and designing a one-page resume, uploading one combined PDF (105 points) and the five-minute interview (80 points)—first impressions, the two guaranteed questions, STAR answers, the four answer criteria and a strong closing. Includes bullet-writing, formatting, STAR and body-language drills and practice scenarios.
